week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas split on Chicago at Atlanta.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 13.5 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Chicago's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 28%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 15%.
